app.name: Ionogram Morphology Lab
home.welcome: Standalone research tool for source-traceable ionogram morphology analysis.
home.disclaimer: Candidate morphology only. Does not confirm physical mechanisms from an image alone.
project.name: Project name
import.blocked: This path is reserved for a blinded scientific study. Access refused.
profile.warning_height: Nominal virtual height — not true physical height
profile.warning_time: Archive time interpretation may be provisional
viewer.no_import: Import a MAT file first. Synthetic demo is available under Synthetic teaching demo.
science.wording_similar: The visible morphology is structurally similar to…
science.disabled_formula: Disabled: exact page and notation have not been verified.
atlas.image_unavailable: Image is not included in the application due to redistribution restrictions. Bibliographic details and source page are preserved.
help.overview: Complete help center: workflow, profiles, cache, viewer, batch, results, uncertainty, abstention, and scientific limitations.
tip.frame_index: One-based archive frame ID. For the KFU profile, frame 1 ≈ 00:00 provisionally.
tip.interpreted_time: Provisional archive time from minute = frame−1. Not metrologically confirmed.
tip.nominal_height: Nominal virtual height axis — not true physical height.
tip.cache: Read-only derived Zarr cache for fast frame access. Never modifies the MAT file.
tip.candidate: Proposed category from rules/features — requires expert review.
tip.confidence: Numerical confidence appears only after calibration. Null means uncalibrated.
tip.abstain: The algorithm may refuse a category when evidence conflicts or O/X ambiguity is possible.
tip.ox: Two branches do not prove O/X modes without polarimetry.
tip.human: Expert decision is stored separately and never overwrites the automatic result.
tip.profile_status: verified / provisional / user-defined-unverified. User profiles are never instrument-verified.
tip.workers: Parallel workers. Defaults stay conservative to avoid exhausting CPU/RAM.
tip.raw_view: Unmodified amplitude display. No hidden smoothing or interpolation.
tip.derived_view: Labeled diagnostic representation — not a replacement for the raw view.
expert_corpus.designation: Pilot expert-review corpus — not a scientific validation set.
